pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: src/app/onboarding/page.tsx:23 The onboarding wizard is a server-rendered Next.js page plus client React steps that talk to the app's own HTTP routes. A case-sensitive search of all of src for electron, ipcRenderer, @tauri-apps, BrowserWindow and contextBridge found nothing, and there is no src-tauri directory, so no native process exists for this subject to govern.

pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: src/app/manifest.ts:5 The only thing that looks like a 'shell' wrapper is a Web App Manifest for PWA installability, with no service worker and no native process. The repo-wide search for electron, ipcRenderer, @tauri-apps, BrowserWindow and contextBridge found nothing, so the native-side ownership rules have nothing to apply to.
pairs.registryProposal: An installable PWA manifest (display: standalone) can look like a native wrapper but gives no capability beyond the document sandbox. The golden path's discriminator could name the PWA case outright, so seats don't treat 'standalone' as a native shell.
